title: Medical Technology - Worldwide
highlights: Revenue in the Medical Technology market is projected to reach US$670.70bn in 2026.
The market's largest market is Medical Devices with a projected market volume of US$576.85bn in 2026.
Revenue is expected to show an annual growth rate (CAGR 2026-2031) of 5.18%, resulting in a market volume of US$863.32bn by 2031.
In global comparison, most revenue will be generated United States (US$246.42bn in 2026).
